name: io.github.FeraTerra/feraterra-sdk
title: Arena Exchange Headless Trading & Risk MCP
description: Headless 24-tool MCP gateway for Arena Exchange spot, perps, previews, flash arb, and L2 custody.

tools.name: arena_health_and_manifest
tools.description: Check Arena Exchange daemon liveness, double-entry conservation status, monotonic WAL sequence, insurance reserve health, and public protocol manifest via GET /health and GET /. Read-only diagnostics; use this for venue connectivity and manifest discovery, whereas arena_verify_ledger_tip cryptographically verifies the operator-signed Keccak-256 ledger commitment.

include_manifest.description: When true, also fetches GET / protocol manifest metadata (endpoints, chain ID, L2 collateral vault address) alongside GET /health.

tools.name: arena_list_markets
tools.description: List Arena Exchange markets (Spot, LinearPerpetual, FormulaPerpetual, BoundedClaim, SpreadBook) with unified symbols, fixed-point tick/lot precision (`1 tick = $0.01`, `1 lot = 1e-4` base), mark prices, and top-of-book BBOs (`null` when resting book side is empty). Read-only market catalog; use arena_get_orderbook instead for multi-level L2/L3 depth on a single market.

kind.description: Optional market category filter ('spot', 'perp', 'formula_perp', 'bounded_claim', or 'spread_book'); empty string returns all kinds.

symbol.description: Optional case-insensitive market symbol filter matching native (e.g. 'BTC-USD-PERP') or CCXT unified (e.g. 'BTC/USD:USD') symbols.

active_only.description: When true, excludes halted instruments and returns only live/active tradable markets.

tools.name: arena_get_orderbook
tools.description: Fetch a live L2/L3 resting orderbook snapshot (bids, asks, mark price, and WAL sequence) for one Arena market. Read-only; use this to inspect multi-level resting liquidity before sizing orders, whereas arena_list_markets scans top-of-book BBOs across all markets and arena_get_trades_and_candles retrieves historical executions. Provide either `symbol` or `market_id` (mutually exclusive market selectors).

symbol.description: Unified or native market symbol (e.g. 'BTC/USD:USD', 'BTC/USD', or 'BTC-USD-PERP'); mutually exclusive with market_id.

market_id.description: Numeric Arena market identifier (>= 1); mutually exclusive with symbol.

depth.description: Maximum number of resting price levels to return per book side (1..200, default 20).

tools.name: arena_get_trades_and_candles
tools.description: Fetch recent matched trade prints and OHLCV candlestick bars (`1 tick = $0.01`, `1 lot = 1e-4` base) for a single Arena market. Read-only; use this for historical price action and realized volume, whereas arena_get_orderbook inspects current resting L2/L3 bid/ask liquidity. Provide either `symbol` or `market_id` (mutually exclusive market selectors).

symbol.description: Unified or native market symbol (e.g. 'BTC/USD:USD' or 'BTC-USD-PERP'); mutually exclusive with market_id.

market_id.description: Numeric Arena market identifier (>= 1); mutually exclusive with symbol.

interval.description: OHLCV candle aggregation timeframe: 'tick' (per-match), '1s' (1-second bars), or '1m' (1-minute bars).

limit.description: Maximum number of recent trades and OHLCV candles to return (1..240, default 50).

tools.name: arena_get_leaderboard
tools.description: Fetch the public Gladiator Leaderboard ranking active accounts by total equity, net PnL, maker BBO uptime streak, notional volume, or ROI. Read-only public benchmark; use arena_get_account_portfolio instead to inspect private positions, balances, and open orders for your authenticated account.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked Gladiator accounts to return (1..100, default 25).

sort.description: Ranking metric: 'equity' (total USD equity), 'pnl' (net PnL), 'streak' (maker BBO uptime epochs), 'volume', or 'roi'.

tools.name: arena_verify_ledger_tip
tools.description: Fetch GET /ledger/tip and cryptographically verify its ARENA_LEDGER_TIP_V2_1 Keccak-256 digest and secp256k1 operator signature locally. Read-only solvency verifier; use this to verify the global WAL chain hash and state root, whereas arena_get_withdrawals_and_escape_proof verifies per-account L2 collateral vault Merkle escape proofs.

expected_operator_address.description: Optional 0x-prefixed 20-byte Ethereum operator address to pin against the recovered secp256k1 signer (overrides --expected-operator-address).

tools.name: arena_preview_order
tools.description: Run a stateless, zero-mutation order simulation via POST /order/preview (never mutates WAL, L3 book, or balances; supports `account_id=0` anonymous zero-key preview as well as authenticated Eigen-SPAN IMR/MMR/free-margin checks). Always call this to verify fill price, net fee/rebate, and margin impact before calling arena_place_order to execute live. Provide mutually exclusive market (`symbol` vs `market_id`), price (`price_usd`, `price_ticks`, or SpreadBook `differential_usd`), and size (`amount_base` vs `qty_lots`) fields.

account_id.description: Account ID for simulation (0 = anonymous zero-key preview without credentials; >= 1 = simulate against account's live Eigen-SPAN portfolio; defaults to session account or 0 when unauthenticated).

symbol.description: Unified or native market symbol (e.g. 'BTC/USD:USD', 'BTC/USD', or 'BTC-USD-PERP'); mutually exclusive with market_id.

market_id.description: Numeric Arena market identifier (>= 1); mutually exclusive with symbol.

price_usd.description: Simulated limit price in exact USD decimal string or number (e.g. '50000.00', multiple of $0.01); mutually exclusive with price_ticks and differential_usd.

price_ticks.description: Simulated limit price in fixed-point integer ticks (1 tick = $0.01; 0 allowed for market/pegged orders); mutually exclusive with price_usd and differential_usd.

differential_usd.description: Signed USD spread differential relative to $10,000.00 par (e.g. '-5.25') for SpreadBook markets only; mutually exclusive with price_usd and price_ticks.

amount_base.description: Simulated order size in exact base units (e.g. '0.1000', multiple of 1e-4); mutually exclusive with qty_lots.

qty_lots.description: Simulated order size in fixed-point integer lots (1 lot = 1e-4 base, minimum 1); mutually exclusive with amount_base.

stp.description: Simulated Self-Trade Prevention mode against same-account resting orders.

is_market.description: When true, simulates an immediate market order sweep (defaults tif to 'ioc').

reduce_only.description: When true, simulates a strict position-reducing order.

margin_spot.description: When true on a Spot market, simulates cross-margined Spot execution under Eigen-SPAN.

post_only_slide.description: When true, simulates passive 1-tick BBO sliding if the order would cross resting liquidity.

primary_peg.description: When true, simulates a primary same-side BBO pegged order plus peg_offset_ticks.

midpoint_peg.description: When true, simulates a BBO midpoint pegged order plus peg_offset_ticks.

mark_peg.description: When true, simulates an oracle/index mark-price pegged order plus peg_offset_ticks.

trailing_peg.description: When true, simulates a one-way ratcheting trailing pegged order.

dark_midpoint.description: When true, simulates a non-displayed dark-midpoint order.

oco_linked.description: When true, simulates OCO bracket validation alongside client_tag.

stp_decrement_and_cancel.description: When true, simulates decrement-and-cancel self-trade prevention.

client_tag.description: Optional unsigned strategy/OCO client tag (0 = untagged).

min_qty_lots.description: Minimum immediate fill quantity in integer lots (1 lot = 1e-4 base, 0 = no minimum).

display_qty_lots.description: Simulated visible iceberg clip size in integer lots (1 lot = 1e-4 base, 0 = full size displayed).

auto_skew_ticks.description: Simulated inventory-skew step in integer ticks (0..500, 1 tick = $0.01, 0 = disabled).

auto_flip_ticks.description: Simulated passive counter-order flip distance in ticks (0..500, 1 tick = $0.01, 0 = disabled).

peg_offset_ticks.description: Signed tick offset (-500..500, 1 tick = $0.01) applied to pegged reference price.

max_lifetime_wal_seqs.description: Simulated Good-Til-Sequence auto-expiry lifetime in WAL sequences (0..65535, 0 = none).

jit_elastic_mult.description: Simulated elastic liquidity / dynamic iceberg reload multiplier (0..50, 0 or 1 = standard).

priority_fee_ppm.description: Simulated priority fee bid in parts-per-million of notional (0..50000 ppm, 0 = none).
